model_source.model: P1 validated ANCF wet structural model
model_source.source_status: P1_ARTIFACT_FOUND; no Re=100/50 m or legacy 604-vertex contract is used

geometry.coordinate_convention: s measured from bottom to top; x=inline, y=crossflow, z=spanwise/reference-axis direction

pretension.contract_note: 1175 N is the HH06 Case 1 benchmark top-tension input. 1188.28 N is the reaction returned by the P1 static-equilibrium solve. It must not be written as the HH06 benchmark input.

mass.model: P1 wet structural mass matrix; include the P1 wet mass definition exactly once
mass.displaced_fluid_mass_included: not_separate; P1 added-mass field is included exactly once
mass.source_derivation: 1.845 kg/m structural line mass; 0.616 kg/m added mass in x/y; totals multiply by L=13.12 m

stiffness.model: P1 ANCF internal elastic stiffness plus prescribed initial pretension
stiffness.global_linear_stiffness_matrix: MASS/TANGENT records for selector REF_NE32 in ancf_static.raw; assembled by the P1 ANCF kernel, not replaced by a 1DOF spring
stiffness.source_note: EA=7.47e6 N is explicitly classified by P1 as a derived core-consistent reference, not source-reported.

damping.modal_or_other_damping: zero damping in P1 eigenproblem and TD2/TD4; hydro damping per length [0,0,0]
damping.source_note: Do not import alpha=0.0194776 1/s from the unrelated 50 m EB/ANCF online plan.

static_initial_state.q0_definition: static equilibrium of the P1 ANCF model before FSI release
included_loads: wet mass/buoyancy terms exactly as defined by P1
static_initial_state.initial_acceleration: not required by this dry-run contract; do not invent a force-free acceleration
static_initial_state.checkpoint_policy: do not fabricate or reuse a 30 s FSI structure checkpoint; 30 s is Fluid restart only

serialized_q0.status: AVAILABLE_IN_P1_ARTIFACT; participant adapter must load/convert the full ANCF state before time integration

ancf_mesh.interface_representation: separate structural coupling mesh; not CFD-face-to-ANCF-node identity mapping

participant_interface.structure_state_mesh_vertex_definition: one section sample at s=2.97 m; full 33-node ANCF state remains internal to the participant
participant_interface.fluid_interface_definition: cylinder face centers from the current P2 CFD mesh
